get.description: Content only from the handover as of `mdt_start` and its findings; reports created or received after it are listed as excluded ('po MDT'). Each section is labelled 'Potvrzeno lékařem' (who, when), 'Návrh AI – čeká na potvrzení lékařem' or 'Chybí', with its notes and missing items, and a blocking readiness item waived at `mark_ready_mdt` is printed next to its section (who, when, reason); a banner and a page header mark the document as a draft (and the file name carries NAVRH) while any section is unconfirmed. Once a KOC physician has signed the MDT conclusion (at or after `mdt_start`), section 6 prints its text as signed, labelled 'Potvrzeno lékařem' with who and when, and section 7 points to it; before that sections 6 and 7 (Závěr, Doporučení MDT) are left for the physicians. The system never writes a conclusion or a recommendation. `format=pdf` renders the same content as a PDF (fonts embedded). KOC team of the case only; every export is audited (with the conclusion's Composition when it is printed).

post.description: Refused transitions answer 409 problem+json with `code` = invalid_transition | guard_failed | case_postponed; a role that may not fire the event answers 403 (`forbidden`, `code` = forbidden_role). A `guard_failed` of `mark_ready_mdt` also lists the blocking readiness item keys in `blocking_items` (read them there, never parse `detail`). The acting role comes from the `X-Demo-Role` header (demo mode). `record_mdt_conclusion` is signed by the acting KOC physician and stores the conclusion text (read it with `GET /cases/{id}/mdt-conclusion`) in the same transaction. `send_feedback` e-mails the referring GP of the case (no clinical text, link to the GP portal) and, once the mail relay accepted the message, the system records it as handed over for delivery (`delivery_confirmed`, receipt = SMTP Message-ID; the GP opening the feedback is recorded separately by `gp_opened`); a mail failure answers 503 `mail-unavailable` and changes nothing. Every event writes an AuditEvent.
